answer: The sheet is drawn through the size, and the drawing must be steady or the size pools. Platen esparto ream counter octavo writ is the drawing: a writ esparto ream counters sign after counting room audits. The knoll is the first draw, made at the trough; the grove is the last, made before the sheets are hung. A cheat must draw 47 false sheets and hang 47 false troughs, and the forge still pools at the edge.
